data.one_liner: Official Flutter Cupertino design library implementing Apple HIG iOS and macOS user interfaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete suite of iOS- and macOS-style visual components, motion, typography, color systems, and theming tools for Flutter applications. It was decoupled from the core Flutter framework into a standalone package.
use_when: Building an iOS- or macOS-styled application or experience in Flutter
Migrating existing code from legacy flutter/cupertino.dart to the standalone package
avoid_when: Building an application exclusively using Material Design
Needing platform-agnostic or cross-platform custom UI kits
strengths: Official Flutter implementation of Apple's Human Interface Guidelines
Complete suite of visual components, navigation, inputs, pickers, and dialogs
Includes compatibility bridging for legacy dependencies
weaknesses: Requires migration steps if coming from legacy framework-integrated cupertino widgets
data.setup_notes: Run flutter pub add cupertino_ui and use dart fix to migrate imports.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose material_ui if you want to implement Google's Material Design system instead of Apple's Cupertino design.

alternatives.name: shadcn_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose shadcn_ui if you prefer a modern web-inspired component look and feel.
